tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the painted panel's off-white, not cream.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, inputs, the site header and the invoice sheet. Always with a line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The black of the logo disc: the footer, and the ground under hero photos.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative: never the only border on a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and any border that carries meaning; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: line-on-band
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the footer and other band areas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on surface and surface-raised. The primary button fill and the rule under section headings.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta and helper text on surface and surface-raised. Never on band in the light theme (2.9:1).

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text, links and icons on band; the hero headline.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band: footer headings and the copyright line. Not on a photo: the hero sentence is on-band at full strength.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: The one accent, from the warehouse wall. Links and script lead-ins on surface and surface-raised; the Vintage badge text on brick-soft; the brick button fill; the current nav underline. Never as text on band in the light theme (3.2:1).

tokens.name: brick-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brick text: the Vintage badge.

tokens.name: on-brick
tokens.usage: Text on a brick fill, such as the brick button's label.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The container blue from inside the warehouse. The New badge text on blue-soft, and the map pin. Nothing else.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind blue text: the New badge.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a blue fill, if one is ever needed.

tokens.name: stock
tokens.usage: In stock, paid, sent: as text on surface, surface-raised or stock-soft. Always beside a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: stock-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind stock text: the In stock and Paid badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, failed payment, sold out: as text on surface, surface-raised or danger-soft, and as the error input border. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Flat 70% band laid over a hero photo so on-band text reads on it. No gradients.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text: an alias of brick, so a theme that moves brick moves links.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Montserrat, the face closest to the logo ring. Uppercase and tracked, except h3.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: BAGS OF VINTAGE AND NEW STOCK
styles.usage: Section headings, uppercase, usually under a script lead-in.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Product names and card titles. Sentence case: the one display style that is not uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Nav links, form labels, footer headings, table headings. Uppercase, like the ring on the logo.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, basket totals and the invoice total, with tabular numerals.

groups.name: Script
groups.note: Sacramento stands in for the hanger script on the logo. One short lowercase phrase at a time.

styles.name: script-lg
styles.usage: Over the hero headline, in on-band. 36px/40px under 600px.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: A one-to-three-word lead-in above an h2, in brick. Never a heading on its own, never a sentence.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Source Sans 3, close to the small bold line on the logo. Everything that is read.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: New and secondhand clothing, sold by the bag.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a page title or hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Order online for delivery anywhere in the UK, or come in and pick and choose.
styles.usage: Running text, product descriptions, form inputs, table cells. Keep lines under 65 characters.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; day names in the hours table.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Product meta, helper text, the copyright line and invoice footers.

spacing.note: 4px base. Nine steps; nothing in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a script lead-in and its heading.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between a label and its input; between card lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; the badge inset on a product photo.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The desktop side gutter; gaps between product cards; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; footer column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones; the footer's top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The hero's top padding; the window pitch on the cover.

radius.note: Square by default, like the warehouse. Round only what is a disc or a pill.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, images, sections, tables, the invoice: everything that is not a control.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, the basket count, the logo disc.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One exception for things that float.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid brick (box-shadow, so it follows the radius). 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The phone menu panel only; the basket is a page, not a drawer.
